ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that points $A$, $B$, and $C$ are on the same line segment, $M$ is the midpoint of segment $AC$, $N$ is the midpoint of segment $BC$, and $AM=5\, \text{cm}$, $CN=3\, \text{cm}$. What is the length of line segment $AB$ in centimeters?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $M$ is the midpoint of line segment $AC$ and $N$ is the midpoint of line segment $BC$,\\
it follows that $MC = AM = 5\,\text{cm}$, $BN = CN = 3\,\text{cm}$,\\
therefore $AB = AM + MC + CN + NB = \boxed{16}\,\text{cm}$.
